_comment: Onboarding-focused set: how a student gets from zero to a real build/flash/debug loop on real hardware or the sim. Sources are this project's own MIT-licensed docs (cads-zero), not the copyrighted RM0090/PM0214 manuals - see README's licensing note. cads-zero's source repo is currently private, so this reads from the local checkout (localRoot) rather than fetching over HTTP; docBaseUrl (the public Pages site) is still used for citation URLs a student can actually click. Extending this to the full doc tree is mechanical.
